outcome: bronchiolitis severity (defined by positive pressure ventilation [PPV] use)
biological characteristics (nasopharyngeal metatranscriptome and transcriptome data)
cohort: The study included 398 infants (age <1 year, 59% male) hospitalized for bronchiolitis across multiple centres.
finding: Four distinct mycotypes of infant bronchiolitis were identified, with mycotype C infants showing a significantly lower risk of PPV use (7% vs. 1%, adjOR, 0.21; 95% CI, 0.02-0.90; p = 0.033) compared to mycotype A infants, and unique dysregulated pathways.
